settings.help: Experimental online-multiplayer path: replaces the repack's Goldberg single-player emu with the online-fix stack and bridges the host Steam client for its activation. Requires the host Steam client running with Spacewar (appid 480) installed; a join freeze at server connect is a known open issue. The row also surfaces on Android, where the fix is untested.
settings.label: Online fix

description: Bodycam (Reissad Studio 2024 UE5 ultra-realistic multiplayer shooter built around bodycam footage, via Proton; single-player on the repack's Goldberg emu, experimental online fix opt-in)
